entities.name: IspD Q47LV0
observations: Exact 249-aa query sequence match to reviewed Thermobifida fusca protein Q47LV0, annotated as 2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 4-phosphate cytidylyltransferase (IspD).
Catalyzes MEP + CTP + H+ → 4-CDP-2-C-methyl-D-erythritol + diphosphate (EC 2.7.7.60; Rhea RHEA:13429).
Pfam IspD domain PF01128 detected at residues 13–244.

entities.name: MEP isoprenoid pathway
observations: IspD catalyzes step 2 in the methylerythritol phosphate pathway for isopentenyl diphosphate biosynthesis.
